latestVersion.changelog:
Jupiter Text to Video 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate 30-second AI-powered videos from text descriptions or uploaded TXT/DOCX/PDF files.
- No editing experience required—just describe your idea and get a 1080p MP4 video in 1-2 minutes.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB; accepts major video, audio, and text formats.
- Cloud-based workflow requires no local installation; rendering occurs on remote GPU nodes.
- Built-in session management, credit tracking, and seamless export/download process.
- Designed for marketers, content creators, and social media managers seeking fast, camera-free video creation.
